title: Exact derived normalization of the Etale comparison path
statement: For every commutative ring, chosen Cartesian square and bounded-below input, the Etale derived path equals the exact derived image of comparisonSquareEtalePath, precomposed with comparisonSquareSourceIso.inv and postcomposed with comparisonSquareTargetIso.hom. These paths and endpoint factors are the explicit constructions of [stage3-proetale-comparison-square-paths]. This asserts only one path identification; it assumes and concludes no square coherence. The square is supplied by an IsPullback proof. The assertion is HEq between the derived ordinary path composite and the stated component path, retaining their definitionally equal endpoint presentations to avoid expensive kernel conversion.

proof.text: Apply the proved exact-derived square-pasting identity to the two edge comparisons at f and g-prime. Naturality of mapDerivedCategoryCompIso in its first functor inserts the etale square whiskered by the comparison pullback. Cancel the endpoint composition factors. This gives exact_path, the three-factor normalization before replacing exact pro-etale pullbacks by total left derived functors.

Prove restriction_path for arbitrary exact functors: the fully faithful bounded-below inclusion sends the composite of two restricted composition comparisons and a middle transport to mapDerivedCategorySquareIso. Obtain the inverse comparison from equality of isomorphisms. Prove plus_transport by equality induction. For any CommSq of schemes, prove plus_square_expansion by unfolding Etale.pullbackSquareComparison and reflexivity. Map this equation to components and apply restriction_path to obtain square_restrict with the ordinary square comparison expanded explicitly. This helper takes CommSq directly: it does not reconstruct a chosen Cartesian square or require conversion between its projected commutativity square and the original one.

Expand leftDerivedUpperStarComparisonIso: its bounded-below compatibility is the identity, leaving the exact-derived edge comparison followed by the inverse exactness isomorphism. In exact_path_with_comparisons apply naturality of the inverse exactness isomorphism at g-prime twice, to the edge comparison at f and to its endpoint exactness isomorphism. These give precisely the last factors of comparisonSquareTargetIso. Expand the source and target isomorphisms, evaluate at M.obj, and combine with the restriction identity for the etale square. No pro-etale square normalization or underived coherence hypothesis is used. The private exactOrdinaryPath, exactSourceIso, exactTargetIso and exactDerivedPath constructors retain the explicit parenthesizations of the public path definitions. Their specialization equalities are reflexivity lemmas, so all normalization of these constructors takes place in the abstract categorical proof. Prove the private normalization_aux with an arbitrary bounded-below square-component morphism and its restriction equation. Combine exact_path_plus, the supplied restriction equation, and the two edge_derived equations there, where the component is a variable. Specialize normalization_aux to the actual pullbackSquareComparison component and square_restrict at sq.toCommSq. Both occurrences now use the identical commutative-square argument, preventing expensive kernel normalization of the concrete derived comparison during conversion. The exported theorem statement is unchanged.

proof_origin.note: E3: complete Lean proof using the already proved exact-derived square-pasting theorem. Generic restriction_path and explicit ordinary/bounded-below square expansion equations avoid expensive concrete conversion. All private helpers are proved; no new obligations or public interface changes. G3 (2026-10-20): upstream-sync repair. Unfold the comparison directly instead of calling the removed _def lemma. Generalize the private restriction helper to CommSq and combine the path equations with a variable component before specializing. This avoids the concrete-square conversion that timed out after the upstream cached interface disappeared; the repaired file compiles within the unchanged limit. All helpers are proved and the exported signature is verbatim.

lean.statement:
theorem comparisonSquareEtalePath_normalization
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{u}} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (M : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))) :
    HEq
      (comparisonSquareDerivedPath Λ g' f' f g (comparisonSquareEtalePath Λ
        { toCommSq := sq.toCommSq, isoPullback := sq.isoPullback,
          hom_fst := sq.isoPullback_hom_fst, hom_snd := sq.isoPullback_hom_snd }) M)
      ((DerivedCategory.Plus.ι ⋙ D(ν^*(X')[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ])).map
            ((Etale.pullbackSquareComparison (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) sq.toCommSq).hom.app M) ≫
          (leftDerivedUpperStarComparisonIso g' Λ).hom.app
            (D+(Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj M) ≫
          L(ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g').map
            ((leftDerivedUpperStarComparisonIso f Λ).hom.app M))
